# Route 2

Route 2 is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Route2 Logistics is a specialist haulage and pallet distribution company providing pallet deliveries across Scotland, England, and Ireland. Route 2 employs 9 people (-18.2% YoY, -2 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in Dunfermline, Scotland, United Kingdom.

## About

Route2 Logistics (R2L) is a specialist haulage and pallet distribution company providing pallet deliveries across Scotland, England and Ireland.

With Depots in Dunfermline, Telford, Milton Keynes, Maltby, and Bristol we are strategically positioned to deal with your logistic requirements.

# R2 Logistics

R2 Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. R2 Logistics is a reliable supply chain solutions provider of transportation and logistics services. They offer services such as ocean, intermodal, truckload, expedited & air, flatbed & specialized transportation, reverse logistics, technology, carriers, resources, and blog. R2 Logistics employs 164 people and has an annual revenue of $4M, founded in 2007. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, United States, with an office in Jacksonville.

## About

Founded in 2007, R2 Logistics is a global provider of transportation services and logistics solutions. As a third-party logistics company, we provide access to thousands of transportation providers and have the capacity to resolve all your shipping needs.
